fields.name: period
fields.description: Construction period of the building, 1 to 9. This is the twenty year cycle the building was completed in, or last renovated heavily enough to reset, and it is fixed for the life of the building. Periods change at Li Chun in early February, so a building finished in January 2024 is a Period 8 building. Defaults to the period in force now.

fields.name: facing
fields.description: The mountain the front of the building faces, by id or by compass label such as S2. Send this or facingDegrees, not neither. The facing side is the open, active, public side, which is not always the side with the front door.

fields.name: facingDegrees
fields.description: The compass bearing the front of the building faces, 0 to 360 degrees, measured looking out from inside. Resolved to one of the 24 mountains. Send this or facing, not neither.
